import java.util.*;

public class EdE_Variant1 {

    private static final int MOD = 998244353;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long n = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long k = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());

        long[] fact = new long[200001];
        fact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 200000; i++) {
            fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % MOD;
        }

        if (k >= n) {
            pw.println(0);
            pw.close();
            return;
        }

        long ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= n - k - 1; i++) {
            long comb = fact[(int)(n - k)];
            comb = comb * modInverse(fact[i], MOD) % MOD;
            comb = comb * modInverse(fact[(int)(n - k - i)], MOD) % MOD;

            long term = comb * modPow(n - k - i, n, MOD) % MOD;
            if (i % 2 == 0) {
                ans = (ans + term) % MOD;
            } else {
                ans = (ans - term + MOD) % MOD;
            }
        }

        if (k != 0) {
            ans = (ans * 2) % MOD;
        }

        ans = ans * fact[(int)n] % MOD;
        ans = ans * modInverse(fact[(int)k], MOD) % MOD;
        ans = ans * modInverse(fact[(int)(n - k)], MOD) % MOD;

        pw.println(ans);
        pw.close();
    }

    private static long modPow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        base %= mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % mod;
            }
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    private static long modInverse(long a, long mod) {
        return modPow(a, mod - 2, mod);
    }
}
